messages:
maria_keller: Heads up — Depot A just scanned an incoming RMA shipment (RMA-78921) and the manifest count doesn't match. Expected 5 cards back from the field, received 6. One card has no depot tag or ticket sticker.

alex_cho: ugh. can you paste the scanned serial list?

maria_keller: Sure — they sent a photo of the packing list and did an echoed scan. From photo:
```
SN: GPU-9X74-3345
SN: GPU-9X74-3346
SN: GPU-9X74-3347
SN: GPU-9X74-3348
SN: GPU-9X74-3349
SN: UNKNOWN-UNTAGGED-001
```

jonah_li: do we have logs tying any node to the unknown serial? maybe customer returned a spare?

infra_ops: Checked inbound scan vs our outbound manifest for RMA-78921 — outbound only had the five serials ending in 3345-3349. no extra.

maria_keller: Depot says the untagged card is physically present and tested. They ran `nvidia-smi -q` on a test bench and got sensible output but no depot sticker.

alex_cho: ok first step: quarantine the untagged card. no DP re-ship until vendor confirms. tag it with temporary depot id `TMP-RMA-78921-EXTRA` and take photos of PCB and connector sides.

maria_keller: done. photos uploaded: https://depot-a.photos/s/78921/extra1.jpg

jonah_li: also check if any recent node drains referenced an unaccounted serial. grep control-plane logs for the GPU serial on recent drains.

infra_ops: ran a quick grep, nothing obvious. but we did have a cluster incident last week where a swap was done with an unlogged spare (ticket 77654). I'm cross-checking that ticket now.

sre-bot: Automated alert: node gpu-node-42 emitted Xid errors 2026-08-12T03:12Z. Log excerpt:
```
[2026-08-12T03:12:10Z] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 86, GPU crashed
[2026-08-12T03:12:10Z] kernel: gpu_reset: resetting GPU 3b:00
```

alex_cho: that coincides with a replacement window. if that node had a hot-swap with a field spare, it could explain the extra card in the depot. jonah — can you check on-call notes around ticket 77654?

jonah_li: Pulling notes — on-call swapped a failed card from node-42 for a borrowed spare from local cache. They annotated the ticket but didn't record the spare serial. looks like they used temporary label `spare-cache-03`.

maria_keller: so most likely the customer returned both the failed card and the spare they borrowed, and the spare arrived without a depot tag. That would explain 6 vs 5. We still need vendor confirmation before final disposition.

alex_cho: next actions: 
- quarantine untagged card (done)
- tag and photo (done)
- vendor_support to check if spare-cache-03 is registered to any serial in their system
- infra_ops to update RMA manifest and mark as "pending vendor verification"

vendor_support: we received the ticket — we will check if spare-cache-03 maps to any serial in our outbound spare registry. please hold the unit for 48 hours.

infra_ops: updated the RMA record in the tracker: added note "extra unit quarantined; waiting vendor confirmation" and changed state to `awaiting_vendor`. Also created internal follow-up: RMA-78921-EXTRA.

jonah_li: small ops note — since this is a possible double-return, confirm we do NOT accept it into inventory. if vendor says it's our spare, we need to reconcile and reassign; if vendor says it's customer-owned, arrange return to customer.

maria_keller: can we also snapshot the depot test bench results and include `nvidia-smi -q` output? vendor asked for full test logs.

infra_ops: pasted benchmark output in ticket: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=serial,name,driver_version --format=csv` produced serial UNKNOWN-UNTAGGED-001, name Tesla-X, driver 535.101. Output attached to ticket.

vendor_support: update — spare-cache-03 was issued out of our regional cache as serial GPU-9X74-3311. mismatch — that serial isn't the untagged unit. We're escalating to depot operations to pull more photos and PCB markings.

alex_cho: good catch. until vendor can verify, don't re-image or assign the unit.

maria_keller: timeline proposal: vendor has 24h to respond; after that infra_ops will schedule a pickup/return label if vendor wants the spare shipped back, or transfer to inventory if vendor verifies it's ours.

jonah_li: also note for ops playbook — add checkbox for "record spare serial when on-call borrows from cache". will file a small ops change PR.

infra_ops: created PR: https://git.internal/repo/ops-playbook/PR-145 (adds spare serial logging step).

sre-bot: Incident follow-up schedule: reminder set for 1915004800 to check vendor response.

maria_keller: thanks all. I'll hold the thread open until vendor confirms. :thumbsup:

vendor_support: thanks — keeping you posted.

alex_cho: resolved state only after vendor picks or confirms. marking as `blocked:vendor` in ticket.

maria_keller: closing notes: depot will not ship any of the 6 units back into inventory. If vendor confirms it's our spare, we'll record serial and move to spares pool; otherwise we'll prepare return-to-customer paperwork.
